description: Preview and edit draw.io, Mermaid and PlantUML (UML) diagrams inside VS Code.
command.preview.openToSide: Open Diagram Preview to the Side
command.drawio.insertCodeSymbol: Insert Workspace Code Symbol into Draw.io…
config.language: Display language of DrawGraph UI, Settings Drawer, and embedded draw.io editor.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
config.drawio.hideGithubIcon: Hide the small GitHub badge/icon in the bottom-right corner of the embedded draw.io editor.
config.drawio.url: URL of the draw.io embed app. Point this at a self-hosted draw.io (e.g. `http://localhost:8080/`) to work offline or keep diagrams inside your network.
config.drawio.theme: Light/dark mode of the draw.io editor. `auto` follows the VS Code color theme.
config.drawio.customLibraries: Workspace paths or HTTPS URLs of custom `<mxlibrary>` shape library files to mount automatically in the draw.io sidebar.
config.mermaid.theme: Mermaid theme. `auto` picks `default` or `dark` based on the VS Code color theme.
config.markdown.mermaid: Render ```` ```mermaid ```` code blocks in the built-in Markdown preview.
config.markdown.plantuml: Render ```` ```plantuml ```` and ```` ```puml ```` code blocks in the built-in Markdown preview.
config.plantuml.render.auto: Use a local plantuml.jar when `#drawGraph.plantuml.jar#` is set, otherwise the PlantUML server.
config.plantuml.render.local: Always render with a local plantuml.jar (requires Java).
config.plantuml.render.server: Always render with the PlantUML server (diagram source is sent to the server).
config.plantuml.server: PlantUML server URL used for server rendering. The diagram source is sent to this server — use a self-hosted server for private diagrams.
config.plantuml.jar: Absolute path to `plantuml.jar` for local rendering.
config.plantuml.java: Java executable used for local PlantUML rendering.
config.plantuml.dot: Optional path to the Graphviz `dot` executable for local PlantUML rendering.
config.preview.debounce: Delay in milliseconds before the preview updates after an edit.
config.preview.followActiveEditor: Reuse an unlocked preview panel to automatically follow the active Mermaid or PlantUML editor.
config.preview.pngScale: Pixel scale factor used when exporting or copying PNG images (`2` = Retina 2x).
config.preview.pngTransparent: Use a transparent background when exporting or copying PNG images.
config.editor.codeLens: Show `Preview`, `Export`, and `Open in Draw.io` CodeLens actions above diagrams and Markdown diagram fences.
config.toolbar.showQuickMenu: Show the colorful DrawGraph quick-action icon in the top-right editor title bar.
config.exportOnSave: Automatically export a sidecar image file whenever a diagram is saved.
config.exportOnSave.svg: Write a `.svg` file whenever the diagram is saved.
config.exportOnSave.png: Write a `.png` file whenever the diagram is saved.
config.exportOnSaveOutDir: Optional directory (relative to the diagram file, or absolute) where auto-exported images are written. Empty writes next to the source file.
config.drawio.svgColorScheme: Colors of SVG images written by the draw.io editor (`*.drawio.svg` files and **Export as SVG**). Applies the next time the diagram is edited or exported.
config.drawio.svgColorScheme.auto: Adaptive (draw.io default): the image switches to dark colors when the viewer (GitHub, browser, OS) is in dark mode.
config.drawio.svgColorScheme.light: Always the light colors you see in the light editor.
config.drawio.vscodeShortcuts: Let common VS Code shortcuts work while the draw.io editor has focus: F1 / Cmd+Shift+P (command palette), Cmd+P (quick open), Cmd+W, Cmd+N, Cmd+O, Cmd+Shift+N/T/W/X, Cmd+\\, Cmd+1…9, Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+` (Ctrl instead of Cmd on Windows/Linux). Cmd+Shift+P and Cmd+P then no longer toggle draw.io's format panel or print.
